_instruction: Platform adapters. For each platform detected in the target project (or explicitly requested), the installer copies every entry of `files` (src relative to templates/v1, dst relative to the target project root, in list order) with the standard idempotent procedure, and additively merges AGENTS.pm-harness.md into `context_file` (create if missing, append after the PM-HARNESS:START marker check, never overwrite). `detect` lists the paths whose existence marks the platform as present; `always_offer` platforms are offered even when not detected. For claude, `files` forms a local skills-directory plugin named `pm` (.claude/skills/pm/ with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, commands/ and a statically shipped agents/pm-orchestrator.md); for opencode it ships the activation skill, .opencode/commands/ and a static .opencode/agents/pm-orchestrator.md with mode: primary. `agents_dir` and `agent_format` are consumed at RUNTIME (not by the installer), read from the local copy `.pm-harness/adapters/adapters.json`: when the roster is generated, the PM Orchestrator materializes one pointer agent file per roster member into `agents_dir`, using the pointer template matching `agent_format` (defined in teams/pm-orchestrator/SKILL.md; HARNESS-SPEC §7.1 — root agent gets mode: primary on opencode, everyone else mode: subagent). null means the platform has no named-subagent concept. The first entry of `files` doubles as the installed-marker the CLI checks before materializing. Unknown platforms can be added here without code changes. `models` declares each platform's model shape for SPEC §3.0/§3.2: id_format ('model' vs 'provider/model'), effort_levels (null = no effort concept), and how to discover them; consumed at runtime by the root agent's catalog sync and by `harness.py route --platform`.

models.discovery: enumerate configured providers/models (opencode config / models list); ids like anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
session model list (/model); ids like claude-opus-4-8; effort is the session reasoning-effort setting

cursor._note: The .mdc rule doubles as context; Cursor has no AGENTS.md convention.

models.discovery: IDE model picker; best-effort, register the current session model

openclaw._note: Best-effort default following OpenClaw's AGENTS.md + skills conventions; adjust the dst if your OpenClaw workspace maps skills elsewhere.

models.discovery: workspace config; best-effort, register the current session model

hermes._note: Generic adapter (best-effort default): a plain instruction file plus the AGENTS.md merge. Adjust paths here to match your Hermes deployment; no code changes needed.

models.discovery: deployment config; best-effort, register the current session model
